title: VPN fails with authentication error after password change
description: Employee changed password yesterday. VPN now says Authentication failed. Email works fine.
resolution: Saved old password in VPN client. Cleared stored credentials, signed in again with new password, approved MFA. Connected.

title: Cannot print to MUM-3F-East
description: Printer not listed on laptop after moving to 3rd floor.
resolution: User was on Nimbus-Guest by mistake. Switched to Nimbus-Corp and installed printer from Software Portal.

title: Locked out of MFA after phone replacement
description: New phone, old phone factory reset. Authenticator has no accounts.
resolution: Verified identity via video call with ID badge. Reset MFA enrolment. User enrolled new device and changed password.

title: Laptop very slow, fan always on
description: Laptop is 4+ years old, takes 10 minutes to boot. Disk 96% full.
resolution: Cleared 60 GB of downloads, moved files to cloud drive. Still slow. Device eligible for refresh; replacement approved.

title: Clicked link in phishing email and entered password
description: User entered credentials on a fake login page that looked like Nimbus Mail.
resolution: User called Security Hotline. Sessions revoked, password and MFA reset, mailbox rules checked for forwarding. No lateral movement found. User retrained.

title: Lost laptop at airport
description: Laptop left in a taxi on Friday night.
resolution: Reported to Security Hotline within 30 minutes. Device remote-locked and wiped, sessions revoked. Disk was encrypted. Replacement issued next business day.

title: Requested Adobe Acrobat Pro, not in Software Portal
description: Needs to edit contract PDFs.
resolution: Software Request raised. Approved after licence and security review. Added to Software Portal.

title: Wi-Fi very slow on Pune 2nd floor
description: About 12 people report buffering video calls since morning.
resolution: Access point firmware fault. Network team rebooted and rolled back firmware. Speeds normal.

title: Account locked repeatedly
description: Locks every 20 minutes even after waiting.
resolution: Old password saved in phone mail app was retrying. Updated password on phone. Lockouts stopped.

title: Need access to Finance shared folder
description: Joined Finance Ops team this week.
resolution: Manager approved. Finance system owner approved. Access granted next business day.

title: USB drive blocked
description: Needs to copy files for a vendor presentation.
resolution: USB storage is blocked by policy. Advised to share via cloud drive with a named external contact after manager approval.

title: Zoom audio not working
description: Participants cannot hear user.
resolution: Wrong microphone selected in Zoom. Selected headset and tested.

title: Cannot reach Jira over VPN
description: VPN says connected but Jira times out. Other sites fine.
resolution: DNS cache stale. Flushed DNS and reconnected.

title: Personal phone cannot access company email
description: Wants to read email on personal phone.
resolution: MDM work profile not installed. Guided user to enrol. Screen lock enabled. Email working.

title: Ransom note displayed on shared warehouse workstation
description: Files renamed with odd extension, note demanding payment.
resolution: Machine isolated from the network. Security and Endpoint teams engaged. Restored from backup. Root cause: unapproved USB device. Policy reinforced.

title: New joiner temporary password expired
description: Joining date was delayed by two weeks.
resolution: Temporary credentials reissued after HR confirmed the new date.

title: Requested installation of a free file-sharing tool
description: Wants to send large videos to a customer.
resolution: Tool not approved. Advised to use cloud drive with named-person sharing. Offered Software Request.

title: Pasted customer data into an unapproved AI tool
description: Pasted a customer export into a public chatbot to summarise it.
resolution: Reported by user. Security assessed exposure, requested data deletion where possible, and retrained user. No-blame policy applied since reported promptly.

title: Scan to email fails for large file
description: 50 MB scan does not arrive.
resolution: Limit is 25 MB. Used scan to cloud drive.

title: Website blocked by filter
description: Needs to open a logistics partner portal.
resolution: Category review done. Site allow-listed after manager approval.
